subject: english
question:
**Given here are four sentences. The first sentence is in correct order, while the rest of the sentences are jumbled. Pick the option that gives their correct order.**

A. It rained heavily last winter and the little stream near our house became a big river.

B. Luckily the water did not reach any of the houses in our village.

C. But the river carried away our beautiful wooden bridge.

D. It burst its bank and the fields all round were soon full of water.
solution:
The correct answer is "ADBC"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Let's look at the correct sequence of the passage. 
 
• Statement A is the opening sentence of the passage which explains that **Last winter there was a lot of rain, and the small creek outside our house grew into a sizable river.**
 
• Statement D is the second sentence of the passage which explains that **It overflowed its bank, quickly flooding the nearby farmland.**
 
• Statement B is the third sentence of the passage which explains **Fortunately, none of the houses in our community was affected by the flood.**
 
• Statement C is the last sentence of the passage which shows that T**he flood took our lovely wooden bridge away.**

Hence, the correct sequence is A, D, B, C

The correct answer is option 2.

The correct passage is:* **A**. It rained heavily last winter and the little stream near our house became a big river. **D**. It burst its bank and the fields all round were soon full of water. **B**. Luckily the water did not reach any of the houses in our village. **C**. But the river carried away our beautiful wooden bridge.*
